role: F2P observables for the Superstruct 2.0.2 to Zod 3.23.8 configuration-validation migration. Each observation is a target-only postcondition evaluated through the public runtime surface of the repository; the source side must report FAIL and the target side must report PASS for the same predicate.

result_shape.results: map of observation id to "PASS" or "FAIL"
result_shape.loaded: bare modules loaded during the run (dependency-policy observations assert superstruct is absent)
result_shape.loadErrors: module keys that failed to load

harness.note: Live source/runner and target/runner.js entries are created by the INTEGRATION batch; this batch only declares the batch-local probe entries.
